title: Central opencode REST subset (2.2.7, live-probed)
description: HTTP surface Central uses for OpencodeGateway, read from the live 2.2.7 OpenAPI (139 paths) and exercised on 2026-11-17: session.create -> prompt -> assistant message with tokens; permission list (empty under default auto-approve rules). The permission reply cycle is schema-captured but NOT live-denied. Central polls message + permission lists per observe(); the SSE stream (/api/event) is intentionally unused.

provenance.liveHandshakeVerified: Basic auth, session.create/prompt/message/permission list on 2.2.7; permission reply + interrupt schema-only

transport.spawn: per-session `opencode serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 0 --stdio` with OPENCODE_PASSWORD=<per-session secret> in the child environment
transport.stdio: first stdout line is {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:<port>"}; stdin must stay open or the server exits; auth state is the env secret, never the stdio bytes
transport.auth: HTTP Basic, username `opencode`, password the per-session env secret, on every request
transport.polling: observe() polls GET message + GET permission; no SSE, no shared server across sessions

GET /api/info.note: health + version pin, called once at open

response.data: the user message echo {id, sessionID, type: user}

POST /api/session/{sessionID}/prompt.note: a timeout after the write is OutcomeUnknown: the turn may still run, never resend

GET /api/session/{sessionID}/message.completionRule: the turn is complete when an assistant message newer than the prompt carries time.completed; Central matches it and emits one completed-turn observation

GET /api/session/{sessionID}/permission.source: live 2.2.7 (empty under default rules); shape from OpenAPI

request.decision: once|always|reject (Central sends once|reject only, never always)

POST /api/session/{sessionID}/permission.mapping: domain approved -> once; domain declined:<feedback> -> reject with message=feedback
POST /api/session/{sessionID}/permission.note: NOT live-exercised: the echo/default lab never asked

POST /api/session/{sessionID}/interrupt.note: best-effort in-turn stop; cancel() still terminates the owned server process for the identity-checked kill guarantee

toleratedOpaque.note: Every other path (message deltas, inbox, forms, artifacts, mcp, schedule, voice, experimental/*) is never a domain fact. Usage counts stay evidence-only notes.
